reason: I have been through two ERP rollouts that promised to save us time and cost us months. A new tool that my buyers have to log into, for $2,000 a month, is exactly what I am wary of. I would take the free six-week test with exports, but I would not sign a paid pilot until it has caught a real late order that we missed.
objection: Does it catch anything my buyers do not already catch by phone and by reading acknowledgements every morning, and is it one more login they will ignore after week two?
would_change_my_mind: In the free test, it flags a real short ship or backorder that would have hit a work order, early enough that we could act on it, and my buyers do not have to log into anything new.
